name: 4th Gen Wireless Earbuds
subtitle: Bluetooth earbuds with charging case
description: These true wireless earbuds feature Bluetooth connectivity, built-in microphones, touch controls and a compact charging case. With up to 30 hours of total playback when used with the case, they are designed for everyday music, videos, calls and casual gaming.
story: The 4th-generation inspired design focuses on a simple true wireless setup for daily listening and communication. Low-latency support helps improve audio synchronisation for videos and casual gaming, while touch controls keep playback and calls accessible from the earbuds. The in-ear fit is intended for regular movement, commuting and light workouts. Built-in microphone support and compatible voice assistant functions add everyday convenience, while the charging case provides additional playback time and keeps the earbuds together between uses.

specs.water_resistance: Suitable for sweat and light splashes

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
